[SWS_ComM_00637]
Upstream requirements: SRS_ModeMgm_09083
⌈In state COMM_FULL_COMMUNICATION and the Network Manager module indicates
ComM_Nm_BusSleepMode() ([SWS_ComM_00392]), the ComM channel state ma-
chine shall switch to state COMM_NO_COMMUNICATION.⌋
Rationale for [SWS_ComM_00637]: A user may request to keep the bus awake "too
late" (NM is not able to send a vote to keep the bus awake because the cluster already
agreed to shutdown).
